pages.title: Brazil cities
pages.text:
Brazil cities
The five most populous Brazilian municipalities, using IBGE's 2026 population estimates (reference date: 1 July 2026):
Rank | City / municipality | State | Estimated population
1 | São Paulo | SP | 11,911,337
2 | Rio de Janeiro | RJ | 6,731,133
3 | Brasília (Federal District) | DF | 3,009,996
4 | Fortaleza | CE | 2,582,360
5 | Salvador | BA | 2,559,945
These are municipal population estimates, not metropolitan-area totals or a live head count. The official IBGE estimate is dated 1 July 2026.
Sources
IBGE, 2026 municipal population estimates (PDF)
Estadão, “Quais são as 15 cidades mais populosas do País? IBGE divulga nova lista”
